name: Kuramoto Chihaya
source:
A patient of Sakaguchi's at Jomiya General Hospital who suffers from acute gastritis. She visits her boyfriend who is currently staying at the hospital after her own discharge.

Sakaguchi set her up as a pawn, thinking she could be used in some way, but she doesn't seem to mind and, on the contrary, enjoys having sex with him.

She is the epitome of free-spiritedness and holds no taboos about sex.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1134]Getchu[/url]]
